detail: 태그를 제거한 결과가 원문과 다름 (모델이 텍스트를 고쳐 씀)
text: Mysticism can be distinguished from other forms of religious belief and worship by its emphasis on the direct personal experience of a unique state of consciousness, particularly those of a peaceful, insightful, blissful, or even ecstatic character.
